Hi Liam,

Thanks again for taking the initial call last week — great to hear about Edgewave's plans for a faster, cheaper inference path for your summarization pipeline. Per our conversation, I put together a short 30-minute demo that walks through latency/cost tradeoffs on a 512-token workload and our deployment options (hosted vs. dedicated).

Proposed slots:
- Tue Jun 29, 11:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Jun 30, 09:00–09:30 PT
- Thu Jul 1, 14:00–14:30 PT

Attached: Redwood_Demo_Agenda.pdf and a one-sheet on pricing (Redwood_Prices_Summary.xlsx). If none of the windows work, happy to share a brief recording or do a shorter 15-minute sync with your infra lead.

Would you prefer one of those slots? Also cc'ing Marcus (AE) so we can bring the right engineer if needed.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:43:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo — Redwood inference evaluation

Neha,

Appreciate the follow-up and the materials — looks solid. I wanted to give you a heads up: we just had an all-hands roadmap refresh and our data platform team is being pulled to prioritize an MLOps consolidation project through Q3. That means the LLM/inference pilot is being moved to the backlog for now.

Two quick things:
1) We're traveling heavy in July (several of the folks who would join the demo are out).
2) Leadership has asked us to defer new third-party pilots until after the consolidation work completes (targeting early Q4).

Can we park the demo for now? I still want to keep you looped — can you check back with me in mid-September? If anything changes earlier I will reach out.

Thanks for understanding,
Liam O'Connor
Director, Data Platform | Edgewave Inc.
liam@edgewave.com

Hi Liam — thanks for the clarity and for flagging timing. Totally makes sense to avoid adding noise while you consolidate. We'll park the demo and remove the invites for the June/July windows.

Two favors if possible:
- Would you share the top 2–3 criteria you'll use to reprioritize this in Q4? (e.g., cost per 1k tokens, latency P95, on-prem support)
- Is there someone on your team we should re-engage in September other than you?

I'll set a tentative reminder for mid-September and keep the demo materials on file. If you'd like a one-page comparison vs. your current infra to hand to leadership, happy to put that together.

Best,
Neha
